blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Repair automatic combat feedback causality and restore authored-arena spatial integrity while delivering the required visual HUD choice hierarchy in the same bounded release-convergence iteration.

diagnosis.root_cause: Automatic lantern attacks reach authoritative combat state but the product-owned Effects path remains silent or misrouted, while the authored mausoleum/landmark collision and camera occluder disagree during ordinary traversal, causing Warden visibility loss.

stop_conditions: Stop after both bounded repair families have direct black-box and white-box retest evidence ready for Tester.
Do not schedule deferred dense-profile native qualification or backlog evidence umbrellas as implementation work.

Preserve the authored cemetery package, native street hierarchy, retained weapon resources, Montserrat HUD typography, and existing camera occluder/fade mechanism unless direct evidence proves incompatibility.

strategy.rationale: Apply materially different root-cause treatments: isolate and correct product-owned combat/audio event routing while retaining native weapon audio, and rebase landmark collision/visibility and movement boundaries onto authored geometry rather than repeating camera-transform tuning. Implement the required choice hierarchy alongside the spatial repair so each required gap is covered exactly once.

code: Run focused candidate checks for attack event identity, audio deduplication, AUTO cadence/release/reset, upgrade delta filtering, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus-state logic.
Verify authored map child meshes and retained weapon assets remain intact, with no destructive asset surgery or proxy-floor substitution.
runtime: Tester/GameLoop Runtime recaptures one SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap with Effects and Master audio, source-event timeline, release, pause/retry/reset/title lifecycle stops, and runtime logs.
Tester/GameLoop Runtime recaptures spawn, critical route, central landmark approach/contact/departure, perimeter/boundary, and ordinary movement replay using spatial-coordinate and movement probes.
Tester/GameLoop Runtime recaptures level-up/choice cards at native resolution with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus transitions; Tester judges both host-gated checks and active issue closure.
visual: Capture shipped gameplay frames for the repaired route, central building/landmark, and perimeter with the same framing as the failed occlusion sample.

Capture HUD choice cards showing silhouette-led hierarchy, truthful current-to-new deltas, and distinct focus states; capture adjacent SEMI/AUTO transient frames to rule out duplicate report replay or masking impacts.

done_when: One SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap each produce exactly one bounded, recognizable firearm transient in mixed output, with native component report isolated from product adapter, miss, concrete-hit, metal-hit, and character-hit stems.

No long ringing material-impact cue masks or substitutes for the firearm report; if no reliable short surface cue exists, player world-surface impact audio is disabled while compact impact VFX and character-hit feedback remain.
AUTO continuation begins only after cadence-valid continuation, stops on release and lifecycle reset, and generic shot VFX does not replay the retained complete player recording.
Focused source inspection identifies event identity, source stem, routing/envelope, and lifecycle-reset changes; same-session runtime audio/state retest is ready for Tester.
tasks.instructions: Trace the authoritative attack transaction through the product-owned audio adapter and combat feedback presenter. Repair the silent or duplicate Effects path so one SEMI click and one quick AUTO tap have bounded onset/impact/recovery causality, retaining the native weapon/component report. Separate miss, concrete-hit, metal-hit, and character-hit handling; prevent long material-impact tails from masking the report; enforce cadence-valid AUTO start plus release, pause, retry, reset, and title-transition stops. Keep impact VFX and character-hit feedback independent and add only focused event/source/timing instrumentation needed for direct Tester retest.
tasks.title: Repair automatic combat causality and Effects audio

done_when: expand the route or provide larger traversable scale around the authored cemetery so ordinary movement has a coherent loop/cross-route.
Include an external world or external depth beyond the playable boundary without silently making the external dressing reachable gameplay space.

Every prominent central building or landmark has aligned collision and stable visibility; no disappearance or occlusion occurs under ordinary movement/movement replay, and perimeter/boundary traversal has no pass-through.
Retain and integrate the candidate-owned camera occluder/fade logic with corrected map geometry instead of transform-only compensation.

HUD weapon/upgrade choices lead with authored silhouettes or equivalent visual icons, use compact stat icons, show truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, never use NEW or LOCKED as CURRENT, and omit unchanged or exhaustive rows.
Choice cards provide distinct keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus, hover, unavailable, and selected states with restrained copy and readable hierarchy.
Focused source inspection identifies spatial anchors and choice rendering/value filtering; same-session movement replay and HUD state probes are ready for Tester.
tasks.instructions: Rebase player movement, landmark collision, camera occluder/fade, spawn exclusion, and perimeter boundary checks onto the authored cemetery's native streets and buildings. Expand or establish larger traversable scale with coherent external world depth, preserving the complete authored environment as authoritative and avoiding proxy-floor replacement. Replay ordinary movement around every side of the central building/landmark and along the full boundary, verifying collision, visibility, and no disappearance or occlusion. In the same task, replace text-stacked upgrade/weapon choices with authored silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new deltas (maximum three), restrained copy, and complete keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states; expose only focused state predicates for inspection, not release-only tester actions.
tasks.title: Restore arena spatial integrity and HUD choice hierarchy
